result.instructions: Tools for ConsignCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which items in our store are still active and priced above $100?"; "Show me the sales from last week and the consignor portion of each."; "Find the account for Jane Smith and tell me her current balance.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ConsignCloud data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run consigncloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run consigncloud_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run consigncloud_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. consigncloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: consigncloud_get_store
tools.title: Get store
tools.description: Get the store the API key belongs to: name, currency, default split and terms, and billing details. Good first call to confirm which store is connected. ConsignCloud API: GET /store.

tools.name: consigncloud_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List inventory items with status, tag price, quantity, consignor account and location. Filter by status, account or location, or search text. Deleted items are hidden. ConsignCloud API: GET /items.

search.description: Narrow items by a text query.

status.description: Only items with one of these statuses, e.g. 'active', 'sold', 'expired'.

account.description: Only items supplied by these account ids.

location.description: Only items at these location ids.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters with it.

tools.name: consigncloud_get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Get one inventory item by id: price, cost, quantity, status, account, location and history. ConsignCloud API: GET /items/{id}.

item_id.description: The item id (a UUID from a list tool).

tools.name: consigncloud_create_item
tools.title: Create item
tools.description: Create one inventory item. Prices and cost are integers in the smallest currency unit (cents for USD: 1250 = 12.50). Account is required for consignment and buy-outright items. Creates a new record each call; it does not check for duplicates. ConsignCloud API: POST /items.

title.description: Item title. If omitted, ConsignCloud builds it from the store template.

account.description: Account id of the supplier (consignor or vendor).

cost_per.description: Cost per unit in cents (USD). Needed for buy-outright and retail items.

split.description: Percent of the split price for the consignor. Consignment only.

sku.description: SKU. Leave empty to let ConsignCloud generate one.

tools.name: consigncloud_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List sales with totals, status, cashier, register and the consignor and store portions. Search by sale number. ConsignCloud API: GET /sales.

search.description: Narrow sales by sale number by a text query.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters with it.

tools.name: consigncloud_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: Get one sale by id: line items, payments, taxes, discounts, totals and status. ConsignCloud API: GET /sales/{id}.

sale_id.description: The sale id (a UUID from a list tool).

tools.name: consigncloud_get_sales_summary
tools.title: Get sales summary
tools.description: Get sales totals for the store over a date range, bucketed for a histogram. Use it for trends by day or week. ConsignCloud API: GET /reports/sales-summary.

start_date.description: Start of the range (ISO date, yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.description: End of the range (ISO date, yyyy-mm-dd).

channel.description: Only sales from these channels. Omit for all channels.

tools.name: consigncloud_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: List consignor and vendor accounts with balance, item count, default split and contact details. Search by name, email or number. ConsignCloud API: GET /accounts.

search.description: Narrow accounts by a text query.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters with it.

tools.name: consigncloud_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get one account by id: balance, default split, contact details, locations and custom fields. ConsignCloud API: GET /accounts/{id}.

account_id.description: The account id (a UUID from a list tool).

tools.name: consigncloud_add_item_note
tools.title: Add item note
tools.description: Add a markdown note to an inventory item. Adds a record; it does not change the item. ConsignCloud API: POST /items/{id}/notes.

item_id.description: The item id (a UUID from a list tool).

tools.name: consigncloud_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (for example, shops or rooms). ConsignCloud API: GET /locations.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters with it.

tools.name: consigncloud_list_item_categories
tools.title: List item categories
tools.description: List the store's item categories. Use the ids as the category field of consigncloud_create_item. ConsignCloud API: GET /item-categories.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Repeat the same filters with it.

tools.name: consigncloud_search
tools.title: Search store
tools.description: Search across the store's records (items, accounts, sales and more) with one text query. ConsignCloud API: GET /search.

query.description: Text to search for, for example a SKU, a name or a sale number.
